Lisa Kakinami <lisa.kakinami@concordia.ca>:
Hello! I am working on a SSHRC grant application and the platform I was planning on using for my ecological momentary assessment fell through. I was hoping to speak to someone to get a quote for this grant application (due this Friday). I know time is very tight, so I will completely understand if that’s not possible. The general details are as follows: -approximately 400 respondents (1) 30 minute online questionnaire at baseline (2) looking to text message people randomly 3 times per day for 5-7 consecutive days and have them respond to 3-6 multiple choice questions via phone/weblink or mobile application (3) ideally to repeat step (2) each season across one year (I’m interested in collecting eating behaviors data) I was planning on recruiting through a survey panel company that I’ve used before, but if that’s too complicated, we can recruit inhouse on our own. Thank you so much in advance! Lisa ----------------------------------------------------- Lisa Kakinami, Ph.D. Associate Professor and Associate Chair Department of Mathematics & Statistics Concordia University------

Lisa Kakinami <lisa.kakinami@concordia.ca>:
Hi Amin, We don’t have news on our SSHRC grant yet, but I was hoping you could give us a quote for a CIHR grant we’re working on. It’s a lot of the same ‘features’ as what we had discussed in the Fall; the details are below to refresh your memory: We would like to message ~400 Canadians (we will come with the list of respondents and their contact information) randomly 3x a day for 7-days, repeated each season. The respondents would be answering in the app a few survey questions (should take ~3-5 minutes each time) and could also answer free-form if they wish. We would like to message them randomly, but within their requested schedule (eg: between 8am and 7pm). If they’re not responding, reminder messages if possible? For this grant, I would like to include all the bells and whistles you had mentioned to me for the SSHRC proposal – the gamification, the physical activity monitoring via google, step count, etc. We would like this to be available in both English and French; we will provide the measures in both languages, but I assume the app would also have to be written in both…? Thank you so much in advance! If we need to schedule a call, please let me know. We have about a month before the grant is due so I’m not as panicked! Lisa

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Lisa, I hope you've had a great weekend, and I apologize for the delayed response. This is Sara from Avicenna, helping Amin with this project. Thank you for reaching out and providing detailed information about the CIHR grant project. It's exciting to hear that you're considering incorporating all those features we discussed for the SSHRC proposal. Based on the details you've provided, here are the estimated quotes for your review: Basic package (surveys only): CAD 3,109.88 + tax With gamification: CAD 6,219.75 + tax With physical activity tracking: CAD 10,155.38 + tax With step count: CAD 14,091.00 + tax Please note that, as per our policy, cost calculations include study gaps as part of the participation duration. However, since this is our first collaboration, we’re happy to consider only 4 weeks of data collection for your project instead of the entire year. Additionally, we have absolutely no limitations on the number of questions in a survey, and also on the number of surveys and notifications within a day. The survey module supports a variety of question types, including freeform text, audio, video, and more. For a full list of question types, you can visit this link. You can certainly configure the study to automatically schedule the survey based on the participants' preferences by gathering this information in a Baseline survey. To set this up, create both a Baseline and Daily survey, then add Time Triggering Logics to the Daily survey. Set the Criteria to send the survey at a specific time or randomly within a time window based on participants’ responses in the Baseline survey. You can also explore Notifications to add reminders to your surveys. Lastly, I’d like to highlight that we fully support localization. The app interface is currently available in 13 languages, including French. You can find more details about localization here. If you’d like to discuss any specific requirements or want to schedule a call to go over the project details further, please don't hesitate to let us know. We'd also be glad to arrange a workshop for your team to ensure you are fully familiar with our platform. Our calendar is shared here for your convenience. Thanks again, and looking forward to working on this exciting project! Best, Sara --Avicenna Research Inc.4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Wednesday, February 5, 2025 at 1:37:42 AM,

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Lisa, I hope you're doing well. My sincere apologies for the delay in getting back to you. Would be glad to be of any help. Regarding the updated quote, I wanted to confirm that we fully support rolling enrollment, allowing you to recruit participants gradually. You can set the "Participation Period" to "Open" (for an indefinite duration) and adjust the "Participation Duration" to reflect the maximum number of days each participant will be part of the study, considering seasonal gaps. You’ll find examples of this setup here. Please note that our licenses are valid for one year by default. If your study extends beyond one year, an additional 20% will be added to the license fee for each additional year. To provide a more accurate quote, could you please share the maximum number of expected participation days for each participant? For the visual assets, I've attached a PDF showcasing the Avicenna Mobile Application to illustrate how the participant app functions. Additionally, the trial version of our platform is absolutely free of charge, and you're more than welcome to try Avicenna as long as needed. You can create a researcher account here and set up a sample study to explore the platform from a researcher's perspective. Afterward, you can install the mobile app, sign up as a participant with a different email, join your study, and experience the participant's perspective firsthand. This approach will help you review everything in detail and share relevant insights with the reviewers. You can also visit our documentation website here to learn more about our research tool. If you'd like, we'd be happy to arrange a workshop for your team to collaborate on a sample project and ensure you are fully familiar with our platform. Feel free to invite as many team members as possible. If you have a sample survey, you can share it with us in advance so we can work on it together during the session. Our calendar is shared here for your convenience. Feel free to choose a time that works best on your end. If you need anything else in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out. Thanks a lot. Best, Sara On Friday, February 14, 2025 at 11:06:51 PM,
